The past, the present, the future, are all equal in their presence.|Tenavik''' to [[Christopher Pike]]'''|2257|Through the Valley of Shadows}} '''Tenavik''' was a [[23rd century]] [[Klingon]] and the [[son]] of [[Voq]] and [[L'Rell]]. ({{DIS|Through the Valley of Shadows}}) He was [[conception|conceived]] shortly before Voq's [[choH'a'|transformation]] into a [[Human]]. Like Voq, he too was an [[albino]]. Knowing she could not be [[pregnant]] while carrying out her duties, L'Rell had the [[embryo]] [[gestate]]d ''[[ex utero]]'' and kept him secret, guarded by [[Ujilli]] at the residence of the [[House of Mo'Kai]] on [[Qo'noS]]. In [[2257]], [[Kol-Sha]] of the [[House of Kor]] [[abduct]]ed the child and tried to force L'Rell to [[abdicate]], so he could become [[Chancellor of the Klingon High Council|Chancellor]]. After Kol-Sha was defeated, the baby was taken by {{Dis|Ash Tyler|Klingon}} to be raised as a {{Dis|monk|occupation}} at the [[monastery]] on [[Boreth]], without ever knowing either of his parents. ({{DIS|Point of Light}}) Due to the nature of the [[time crystal]]s on the planet, he was encountered again a few months later as a grown man by Starfleet [[Captain]] [[Christopher Pike]] who convinced Tenavik to give him a time crystal for the [[Red Angel suit]]. Although he complied, Tenavik warned Pike of the consequences of using one, namely that Pike would see his own future. ({{DIS|Through the Valley of Shadows}}) {{Bginfo|Tenavik was portrayed as an adult by actor [[Kenneth Mitchell]], who had previously appeared as the Klingons {{Dis|Kol|Klingon}} and [[Kol-Sha]].}} == Appendices == === Appearances ===
* {{DIS}} ** {{E|Point of Light}} ** {{E|Through the Valley of Shadows}}
=== Background information === According to [[Kenneth Mitchell]] on an episode of [[Anson Mount]]'s podcast "The Well", Tenavik was originally going to be played by [[Shazad Latif]], but the role was subsequently offered to Mitchell instead due to Latif's beard getting in the way of the makeup. {{EL|thewellpod.com/kenneth-mitchell-time-twp055/}} Episode writers [[Bo Yeon Kim]] and [[Erika Lippoldt]] named Tenavik for the character Navi from the Legend of Zelda video game series. === Apocrypha === Tenavik appears in the "House Reborn" update of ''[[Star Trek Online]]'' released in January 2021; he is voiced by [[Sam Witwer]], under the guidance of Kenneth Mitchell (who could not reprise the role due to his progressing ALS). Tenavik appears briefly in the Boreth monastery during the revamp of the "[[Fek'Ihri]] Return" storyline, when the Klingon player character must go into [[Gre'thor]] to battle the vengeful spirit of [[Molor]]. He plays a more significant role in the episodes "Knowledge is Power" and "Leap of Faith". When the Empire is fractured by the self-declared Emperor J'mpok, Matriarch J'Ula of House Mo'Kai seeks out Tenavik and experiences a time crystal vision, where she witnesses a fiery warrior wielding the [[Sword of Kahless]] (at that time carried by General [[Martok]]). The warrior of fire is Tenavik's mother, L'Rell, whom Tenavik and the Followers of Kahless eventually clone to replace J'mpok. When her soul does not return to her body, however, Tenavik guides the player and their allies back to Gre'thor to find her. === External links === * {{Mbeta}} * {{StarTrek.com|node/15306||external}} [[fr:Tenavik]] [[uk:Тенавік]] [[Category:Klingons]] [[Category:Religious leaders]]
